about: Open-share collection of codes and tools from the MalwareMustDie (MMD) team — a non-profit malware awareness group of network engineers and security researchers (est. 2012). Analysis tooling, log-triage utilities, radare2 material, slides and case notes, organized by implementation language.

categories.description: Shell utilities for log triage, diffing and crawling
C source projects (e.g. the w3bfukk0r web brute-force tool)
Standalone HTML analysis tools (DGA decoders, sample mailers)
radare2 scripts and r2-based analysis material
radare2 test material and practice targets
